requests.prompt: Create a production 2D four-view turnaround sheet for Zhao Ling'er 趙靈兒 from the ORIGINAL 1995 DOS Chinese game PAL1, to reconstruct an animated 3D model. Reference 1 is STYLE ONLY: Li Xiaoyao's approved STYLE D sheet, normal human proportions, matte simplified refined game rendering, hand-painted readable broad forms, restrained natural eyes, no toy or chibi anatomy. References 2 (top-right portrait), 3 and 4 are AUTHORITATIVE IDENTITY/COSTUME: reconstruct Zhao Ling'er faithfully. Her distinctive long straight black hair has TWO small high side buns/tied hair sections, thin long pale blue ribbons, fine separated bangs; soft young Chinese face with modest small natural eyes. White ivory standing mandarin collar and shoulders, pale ivory sleeves, dark cobalt-blue curved chest bib with small white knot at collar, blue-violet ankle-length skirt and modest cloth shoes. Keep that original blue-white visual identity; do not invent generic flowing pastel hanfu, a crown, armor, jewelry or a single ponytail. She is a slender young heroine with NORMAL approx 7-head proportions, long normal legs, appropriately youthful face without infantilizing. Show exact same one character and costume in ALL FOUR orthographic full-body views in a strict evenly spaced 2x2 grid: top-left FRONT, top-right profile facing LEFT (nose points to image left), bottom-left BACK, bottom-right profile facing RIGHT. Heads and feet aligned at identical scale; each view isolated with generous transparent margins, no overlap, no text/labels/watermark/grid lines. Low A-pose: forearms angled slightly away from skirt, hands completely clear of fabric, sleeves compact at wrists; separate shoes visible under long skirt, no thin loose fringe or lace. CONSISTENT anatomy and clothing across four views, balanced diffuse studio light, no cast shadows. NO weapon or staff in the source sheet; weapon is separately rigged later. Render the normal-proportioned woman in precisely the same matte STYLE D material language as reference 1, preserving the original character rather than a modern adaptation. True transparent background.

Preserve the original PAL1 identity, while translating into the precise STYLE D matte 3D-game visual language, never chibi or big-headed short-bodied anatomy. All four costume views consistent.
